evidence.quote: We propose a $35 million class fund, distributed automatically to identified members, plus $3 million in court-approved fees and expenses.
we propose a $30 million class fund plus $3 million in court-approved fees and expenses.

summary: Plaintiff first raised fees as part of its initial settlement proposal, before the class fund amount was settled. Fees remained at $3 million and there is no clear evidence that either side traded fee treatment for a reduced class recovery or that class counsel prioritized its own economics. The court declaration does not materially misstate the fee-negotiation chronology.
